ideas.delivery: The implementer identifies a business use case, creates a pilot agent on a platform such as Docspot, configures it from the business's website or help content, onboards the customer and provides maintenance and periodic reports. uk_legal_risk.reason: The guest recommends cold texting businesses. In the UK, unsolicited marketing texts to individuals and sole traders are generally prohibited under PECR without the required consent; the described small-business prospecting may include sole traders.

ideas.other_uk_rules: For outreach, UK GDPR applies to personal data gathered by scraping; cold email is allowed only to limited companies with an opt-out, and cold calls must be screened against TPS/CTPS. Employment Agencies Regulations 2003 do not appear to apply to agencies implementing software rather than placing workers. UK GDPR data-processing terms are also relevant when agents handle customer support data.
